'''Matt Bryant''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2000 Seattle tournament]] on 5 February 2000 with Abyssin swarm, according to Charles Hickey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d231">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-07-lake-city-washinton-feb-5th-00d231/ lake-city-washinton-feb-5th-00], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 7 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-07-lake-city-washinton-feb-5th-00d231/ GitHub Pages].</ref> On [[Worldwide SWCCG Day]], 26 July 2008, he finished 6th of 12 in round 4 of the Seattle league with 6 (+15).<ref name="sf-22101-318953">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=318953#p318953 SWCCG Day 2008 Results], mserisman (Michael Erisman), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 July 2008).</ref>
